name: Pixel sprite
summary: Pixel sprite generator: any retro game sprite from pixel-map strings and the 16-colour palette, 1-4 frames.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the sprite (centre when centre = true)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; one cell = px * s pixels

params.name: map
params.note: pixel map: rows separated by '/', one char per cell, '.' empty; chars k w g d r o y e f c b n p m u x are palette colours

params.name: frames
params.note: array of 2-4 pixel maps (strings or arrays of rows) to cycle; overrides map

params.name: px
params.note: cell size in px at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: whole-sprite motion, moves in whole cells

params.name: centre
params.note: anchor on the centre instead of the bottom (for icons and effects)

author: krakujs
